title: Tenth Constable's History (தமிழ்)
full_text:
The Tenth Constable spoke:

'A wealthy textile merchant claimed that his warehouse was burgled from the outside by unknown river pirates, claiming ten thousand dinars in insurance from the merchant guild.

I inspected the massive wooden door: it had two iron locks—an outer master padlock and an inner bolt.

I examined the iron shavings around the inner bolt: the scrape marks showed that the bolt had been drawn from the inside while the outer padlock remained completely untouched!

I confronted the merchant’s head clerk: he broke down and confessed that he and his master had hidden the silk in an underground cellar to defraud the guild!

The goods were seized, the fraud was punished, proving that careful physical inspection distinguishes truth from elaborate staged crimes.'
moral: Careful examination of locks and hinges reveals whether a crime was an invasion or an inside betrayal. [TA]
